title: Area Computed by Horizontal Slices (Type II)
author: Muhammad Abdullah Athar
problemStatement: Compute the area of the region bounded by x = y^2 and x = 4 in the right half-plane using horizontal slices.

steps.title: Determine Limits on y for Upper Half
steps.explanation: For the region where 0 <= y <= 2, x varies from y^2 to 4.

steps.title: Set Up and Evaluate Iterated Integral
steps.explanation: Integrate with respect to x first, then y.
